description: Change a finding's status by human identifier such as ODI-12 or internal findingId. Requires an explicit user request and an API key with Read & Write permission; cookie-authenticated callers also need member role. Linked pull request metadata does not grant authority to change status.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

status.description: Target status. MITIGATING (shown in Odin as Fixing) means work has started, OPEN_FOR_RETEST means the fix is ready for verification, and ACKNOWLEDGED (shown as Risk accepted) means the organisation accepts the risk for now.

name: update_finding_status
title: Update finding status
